messages.subject: Pennington Industries / Crossfield Engineering — response to LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

We act for Crossfield Engineering Limited. Our formal letter of response under the Pre-Action Protocol follows by post and email today. In short, liability is denied. Our client's position is that the housings conformed to the specification as agreed following sample approval, that causation is not established, and that in any event clause 11 of the supply agreement excludes consequential loss and caps liability at the contract price (£214,830).

We are, however, willing to engage and would consider a without-prejudice meeting once the key technical documents are exchanged.

Yours sincerely,
Deepa Patel

--
Calderbank Hughes LLP | 5 Temple Gardens, London EC4Y 9AU

messages.subject: RE: Pennington Industries / Crossfield Engineering — response to LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Patel,

Thank you for your letter, which we are considering with our client. We do not accept the characterisation of the sample-approval process, nor that clause 11 has the effect you suggest, but we note your willingness to engage and will revert on the technical document exchange and on ADR in the new year.

In the meantime please ensure your client preserves the mill certificates and machining and raw-material purchasing records referred to in our letter.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 138760 Cheapside | +44 (0)20 7946 0991
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
